name: agentpilot
description: Local-first Codex and coding-agent event dashboard

agentpilot.enableNotifications.description: Show VS Code notifications for real completed Codex turns.

agentpilot.enableWindowsNotifications.description: Also show a native Windows toast when PowerShell and Windows toast APIs are available.

agentpilot.notifyOnAttention.description: Show notifications when a real agent event requires user interaction.

agentpilot.notifyOnErrors.description: Show notifications for real agent errors.

agentpilot.notifyOnCancellation.description: Show notifications when an AgentPilot-owned task is cancelled.

agentpilot.enableTelegram.description: Send selected AgentPilot events through Telegram. The token and chat ID are stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

agentpilot.telegramNotifyExceptionalSess.description: Notify when a session ends without an observed completed turn. Normal SessionEnd events following Stop are suppressed.

agentpilot.usageRetentionDays.description: Days of local token usage metadata to retain.

agentpilot.pricingOverrides.description: Optional per-model API pricing overrides keyed by provider:model. Rates are per million tokens unless unit is specified.

agentpilot.codexCliPath.description: Native Codex executable used by AgentPilot-owned tasks. On Windows use codex.exe, not a .cmd/.bat launcher.

agentpilot.codexTaskModel.description: Optional exact model ID for AgentPilot-owned tasks. Empty uses the Codex default and records model as unknown when JSON output omits it.

agentpilot.codexTaskTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum duration for an AgentPilot-owned Codex task.
